description: GEER reconnaissance mission: Western European Floods Summer 2021 is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "field recon", published or maintained by Nina Stark, University of Florida (ufl.edu). This project documents the observations of geotechnical and geo-structural damage and failure to infrastructure, buildings, utility networks, and the river course due to the 2021 Western European floods. Coverage: Germany, Netherlands, Belgium. DesignSafe files it as a "field recon" project. Keywords: floods, foundation damage, scour, erosion, bridge collapse. Published 2022-05-18. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
